newsitem.title: FINLAND: Postipankki restructure to cut costs FIM 200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Postipankki restructure to cut costs FIM 200 mln.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled commercial bank Postipankki Oy said in a statement on Friday it aimed to reduce annual operating costs by nearly 200 million markka in a restructuring entailing staff cuts.
"Postipankki is planning significant changes in its operating strategy," it said.
"The implementation ... of the projects is expected to save almost 200 million markka per year in the bank's operating expenses," Postipankki added.
The focus of the restructuring was to reduce customers' visits to bank branches in person and instead emphasise Postipankki's telephone banking services, it said.
"The staff reduction need related to the development projects is estimated at a total of 929 man years," it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
